outcome: Crude and adjusted cesarean delivery rates
cohort: 535 nulliparous women with term singleton vertex-presenting fetuses delivered by 12 randomly chosen obstetricians in a single institution
finding: Ranking of obstetricians based on crude cesarean delivery rates varied significantly after adjusting for high-risk maternal conditions and maternal and neonatal outcomes, leading to the development of a new single metric for obstetrical quality improvement called the obstetrical safety and quality index.
